listen_address.description: Address on which the D-Bus broker listens for connections. Typically a Unix domain socket path.

debug.description: If true, enables debug logging (very verbose). Use only for troubleshooting.

max_pending_connections.description: Maximum number of pending (not yet accepted) connections per client.

max_active_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneously connected clients.

max_owned_services.description: Maximum number of unique service names a single client may own.

max_match_rules_per_client.description: Maximum number of match rules a single client may register (for signal filtering).

max_file_descriptors_per_client.description: Maximum number of file descriptors a single client may pass over D-Bus (via unix fd passing).

client_timeout.description: Time (in milliseconds) after which the broker considers a client dead if no ping response is received.

enable_activation.description: If true, enables systemd-based service activation (e.g., on-demand startup of services via D-Bus requests).

service_directories.description: List of directories where service definition files (.service files) reside, used for activation.

path.description: Absolute path to a service directory. Must exist and be readable by the broker process.
